name: H2B-mCherry TSC, 20260822 ZO1 EVT/STB crops (dense, mixed-brightness fields)

rationale.nucleus_channel: AF594 = H2B-mCherry in the 20260822 EVT ND2s (index 1 of AF488/AF594/AF647).
rationale.split_um: Interphase TSC nuclei are ~10-12 um across; seeds closer than a radius are one nucleus.
rationale.min_area_um2: Below any real nucleus or metaphase plate; removes debris and micronuclei from the scan (micronuclei are scored by eye, not here).
rationale.base_min_lo/hi: Compare against the cell 30-60 min earlier: prophase-to-metaphase in mammalian cells is ~20-40 min, so this baseline is still interphase. Chosen by her Claude without calibration; kept because it worked.
rationale.cond/area: MEASURED on 136 hand clicks across all three day groups (crop1_D4_1 35, crop4_D2_3 61, crop7_D0_1 40). ONE setting, top >= 1.4x and area <= 1.0x baseline: D4 34/35 at 139 candidates, D2 50/61 at 218, D0 33/40 at 116 (~3-4 candidates per real mitosis, 82-97% recall). Per-group tuning did not beat it. Misses concentrate in crowded clusters and in the first ~40 min of a movie (no 30-60 min baseline yet).
rationale.fold_um/fold_min: One mitosis spans several frames and the daughters separate ~10-15 um; fold hits closer than that into one event.
rationale.threshold_scale: MEASURED: at 1.0 x Otsu the bright cells pull the threshold up and dim interphase nuclei go unsegmented, so a plate has no 'before' to be brighter than (23/35 found). 0.5 -> 35/35 clicks in a mask, 33/35 at 154 candidates; 0.35 over-segments (452 candidates for 34). crop1_D4_1, 2026-10-23.
rationale.local_bg_frac/bg_window_um/dist_smooth_p: Ported from her segment_field.py (20260822 EVT). Global 0.5x Otsu alone: 33/35 needed 154 candidates; with these, 109.
rationale.signal: MEASURED 2026-10-25: 'top' (brightest point after 1 px blur) instead of mean. In dense D0/D2 fields the watershed merges a plate with a neighbour, which drags mean and area toward interphase; the brightest point is still the plate. D0_1: 33/40 found at 116 candidates with top vs 272 with mean.
rationale.edge_um: MEASURED 2026-10-25: The researcher's review of crop8_D0_1's unclicked candidates marked 6/78 'out of frame' (a cell leaving the field shrinks and passes as a plate), all centred within 8 px of the border. Dropping objects within 7 um (8 px) of the edge loses 0 clicks on crop2_D4_1/crop3_D2_3/crop8_D0_1 and removes 8-18 candidates per field.
rationale.threshold_scale/local_bg_frac (EVT): MEASURED 2026-10-25: in crop1_D4_2 dim interphase nuclei next to very bright ones were never segmented, so their plates had no baseline (34/68 found). 0.35 x Otsu with local_bg_frac 0.15: crop1_D4_2 49/68; over the 7 clicked EVT fields 440 -> 464 of 542 found for +19% candidates. NOT used for TSC batch2 / BeWo (0.58 um/px, single channel): there it found 369 -> 371 of 437 sampled clicks (M1, M3, M6, M9, BeWo M5) for +22% candidates, and ZO1_STB P1-6 335 -> 339 for +13%.
